//***********************************************************************************************************
// Here are two articles to help you get started with KQL:
// KQL reference guide - https://aka.ms/KQLguide
// SQL - KQL conversions - https://aka.ms/sqlcheatsheet
//***********************************************************************************************************

// Use "take" to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.

SampleBicycles
| take 100


// records per street - take 10

SampleBicycles
| take  10
|project Street, No_Bikes

// rename columns

SampleBicycles
| project Street, ["Number of Empty Docks"] = No_Empty_Docks
|take 10

// Summarize data by using KQL

SampleBicycles
| summarize ["Total bikes"] = sum(No_Bikes) 

SampleBicycles
| summarize ["Total bikes"] = sum(No_Bikes) by Neighbourhood
| project Neighbourhood, ["Total bikes"]

// order by

SampleBicycles
| summarize ["Total bikes"] = sum(No_Bikes) by Neighbourhood
| project Neighbourhood = case(isempty( Neighbourhood) or isnull( Neighbourhood) , "Unidentified", Neighbourhood), ["Total bikes"]
|order by Neighbourhood asc 

//------------- TRYING SQL 

 SELECT TOP 100 * from SampleBicycles

 select top 10 Street, No_Bikes
 from SampleBicycles

 select top 10 street, No_Empty_Docks as [Number of empity docs]
 from SampleBicycles

 select sum(No_Bikes) as [Total Bikes]
 from SampleBicycles;

 select Neighbourhood, sum(No_Bikes) as [Total Bikes]
 from SampleBicycles
 group by Neighbourhood;

// treat nulls and order by

 select 
    case 
        when Neighbourhood is null or Neighbourhood = '' then 'Unidentified'
        else Neighbourhood
    end as Neighbourhood,
    sum(No_Bikes) as [Total Bikes]
from SampleBicycles 
group by
    case 
        when Neighbourhood is null or Neighbourhood = '' then 'Unidentified'
        else Neighbourhood
    end
order by Neighbourhood asc
;

    
//filter

 select 
    case 
        when Neighbourhood is null or Neighbourhood = '' then 'Unidentified'
        else Neighbourhood
    end as Neighbourhood,
    sum(No_Bikes) as [Total Bikes]
from SampleBicycles 
group by
    case 
        when Neighbourhood is null or Neighbourhood = '' then 'Unidentified'
        else Neighbourhood
    end
having Neighbourhood='Chelsea'
order by Neighbourhood asc
;
